moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal defending their title.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off next Friday. Who's your money on for the title?

angles.name: Team Specific
angles.copy: Arsenal start their title defence next week as the Premier League season gets underway. Can anyone stop them?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Manchester City face Arsenal in the Community Shield this Sunday, August 16th, at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff, as Wembley is unavailable.

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage! The Community Shield comes to Principality Stadium this Sunday as Man City take on Arsenal. Who's heading down?

angles.name: National Event
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season is up for grabs on Sunday! Man City and Arsenal battle it out for the Community Shield, live from Cardiff.

moments.title: The Weeknd's Wembley Residency
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour to Wembley Stadium for five nights, starting tomorrow, August 14th.

angles.name: Tour Start
angles.copy: The Weeknd is taking over Wembley! His massive 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour kicks off its five-night run tomorrow. Are you ready for it?

angles.name: London Buzz
angles.copy: London is about to get lit! The Weeknd starts his epic five-night residency at Wembley Stadium tomorrow. Expect traffic and pure vibes.

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine' residency at London's O2 Arena on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Pop Event
angles.copy: It's happening! Ariana Grande starts her HUGE ten-night O2 residency this Saturday. Who got tickets to the 'Eternal Sunshine' tour?

angles.name: Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Ariana Grande takes over The O2 from Saturday for a massive 10-night run! If you're heading to the 'Eternal Sunshine' tour, get ready!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival (Sold Out)

angles.name: Sold Out Success

angles.name: Music & Culture
angles.copy: Next week, the We Out Here Festival brings its unique blend of jazz, soul, and club culture to Dorset. It's sold out, but the buzz is real!
